## Context / Problem
`rebar workflow edit` (`src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/workflow.py:73-78`, handler `src/rebar/_cli/_workflow_commands.py:115-116,123-151`) serves a bpmn-js editor from a 2 MB vendored bundle force-included in the wheel (`pyproject.toml:370-373`). ADR 0071 (Proposed) was never implemented. The editor drags a Node 22 toolchain into CI (`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:449-519`), a `make e2e-deps` target (`Makefile:556-579`), a 175 MB untracked `node_modules` tree, and ~7,000 lines of editor-only Python/JS/tests. Operator decision (2026-09-06): remove entirely; the engine, client-authored workflows, and `workflow new|validate|run|show|status|result` stay. Base commit for every cite below: origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
Delete editor-only modules and assets; keep the engine untouched. Inline the two helpers `prompt_library.py` imports from `prompt_authoring.py` (`_valid_id` at `prompt_authoring.py:65-66` with `_SLUG` at `:50`; `_atomic_write` at `:228-239`, which wraps `rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write`) into `src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompt_library.py` (sole surviving importer, `:185` and `:254`), because the module-size policy forbids creating a new sub-100-LOC module. Remove the `edit` subparser and dispatcher branch, the `REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT` resolver chain (`src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:407-418`, re-exports `_config_sources.py:62`, `config.py:82`), the workflow package's bpmn exports (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/__init__.py:31,71,85,90`), and every build/CI/test hook that exists only for the editor or its Node harness. Regenerate committed artifacts (`scripts/gen_cli_help.py`, `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py`, `scripts/gen_env_registry.py`) rather than hand-editing them. The Python and JS halves land in ONE change because `tests/unit/workflow/test_editor.py:299` fetches `/assets/editor.js` and `tests/e2e/conftest.py` starts the editor server on the Node-provisioned lanes (`_build-and-test.yml:470-475` pins Node 22), so either split ordering is red. Shrink-only ratchets bucket the removals as `stale`; no baseline is hand-edited.

Classification (callers on origin/main): KEEP `lint.py` (`executor.py:48`, `_cli/_workflow_commands.py:234,272`), `lint_refs.py` (`lint.py:27`), `lint_expr.py` (`lint_refs.py:34`; owned by the LLM-leftovers epic), `step_contracts.py` (`executor.py:63`, `interpreter.py:77`, `steps.py:33`, `plan_review/decide_ops.py:49`; docstring edit at `:7-8`), `render.py` (`render_workflow` MCP tool), `errors.WorkflowAssetsUnavailableError` (`llm/errors.py:184-187`, public taxonomy pinned by `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_error_code_taxonomy_contract.py:95`; reword docstring). REMOVE `editor_contracts.py` (callers `editor.py:38-40`, `editor_server.py:241,377` only), `criterion_preview.py` (callers `editor_server.py:293,378` and `scripts/t5c_calibrate.py:15`, a 74-line one-off allowlisted at `scripts/check_import_walk.py:103-105`), `rebar.moddle.json` (only `tests/unit/workflow/test_bpmn.py:404-407`). `hatch_build.py` and the MCP surface are untouched (no editor logic, no editor tool). The `ui` extra (`pyproject.toml:95-102`) is the audit web UI and STAYS. `.github/workflows/codeql.yml:49` keeps `javascript` (7 JS files survive under `infra/terraform/auth/`); only the comment at `:47` is rewritten.

## Scope
Delete (git rm): `src/rebar/llm/workflow/{editor.py,editor_server.py,editor_contracts.py,bpmn.py,criterion_preview.py,prompt_authoring.py,rebar.moddle.json}`; `src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/` (all 13 tracked files incl. `dist/editor.{js,css}`, `.gitignore`); `tests/e2e/` (whole tree); `tests/unit/workflow/test_{bpmn,editor,editor_batch,editor_effective_policy,editor_roundtrip,editor_validate,prompt_authoring}.py`; `tests/unit/test_criterion_preview.py`; `tests/unit/test_browser_tier_optout.py`; `scripts/t5c_calibrate.py`.

Edit: `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/workflow.py:4` docstring and `:73-78` (delete `p_edit` block); `src/rebar/_cli/_workflow_commands.py:3`, `:115-116`, `:123-151` (`_workflow_edit`); `src/rebar/llm/workflow/__init__.py:31,71,85,90` and editor mentions in its docstring; `src/rebar/llm/workflow/step_contracts.py:7-8`; `src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompt_library.py` (add `import re` and `from rebar._store.fsutil import atomic_write`; define `_PROMPT_ID_SLUG`, `_valid_id`, `_atomic_write` above `_validate_id`; drop the two lazy imports; rewrite comments at `:61-68`, `:183-184`, `:249-253`); `src/rebar/llm/criteria/ids.py:6,26` docstring cites; `src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:407-418` delete; `src/rebar/_config_sources.py:62` and `src/rebar/config.py:82` drop re-exports; `src/rebar/llm/errors.py:185` docstring; `pyproject.toml:370-373` (comment + `artifacts` glob), `:382-383,388,403` (`**/node_modules` excludes + comment), `:743` (`e2e` marker); `Makefile:74` (drop `e2e-deps` from `.PHONY`), `:556-580` (delete target); `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:449-486` (delete comment block + two Node steps), `:493-519` (delete the `make e2e-deps` guard; keep `:488-492`); `.github/workflows/codeql.yml:47` comment -> `# javascript covers the infra/terraform/auth Lambda sources;`; `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py:58` (drop `EXCLUDED_FILES` entry); `scripts/check_import_walk.py:102-106` (empty the `SCRIPTS_SKIPS` dict, keep the name); Tests: the 15 files with line-level edits are listed in this ticket's first comment (notably `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py:1848,1915` drop `"e2e-deps"` and the test-corpus epic owns every other assertion in that file). Regenerate: `src/rebar/_cli/help/workflow.txt`, `docs/cli-reference.md:1158-1169`, `docs/env-vars.md:144`. `docs/calibration/T5c_trust_boundary.md:8-9` -> "Reproduce: the one-off `scripts/t5c_calibrate.py` was removed with the editor in commit <this story's sha>; restore it from `<sha>^` to re-run."

Out of scope: other docs (the docs story); `lint*.py` and `gate_dispatch.py` (LLM-leftovers epic); `docs/experiments/**` and `tests/fixtures/**` prose; `.github/*-baseline.json` (ratchets self-report `stale`).

## Testing
Deleted tests are editor-only. The relocated helpers keep their oracle in `tests/unit/test_prompt_library_writes.py` (`test_create_invalid_id_raises` :199, `test_create_accepts_uppercase_id` :299, atomicity at :264/:280 patch `os.replace`). Removal is proven by absence: CLI parse of `workflow edit` is a usage error; `import rebar.llm.workflow.editor` raises `ModuleNotFoundError`; the built wheel contains no `editor_assets`. `make verify` is the CI-equivalent gate.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `rebar workflow edit x.yaml; echo $?` prints a usage error naming `{new,validate,run,show,status,result}` and exits non-zero; `rebar workflow --help` does not contain `edit`.
- [ ] `python -c "import rebar.llm.workflow as w; print('bpmn_to_ir' in w.__all__)"` prints `False`; `python -c "import rebar.llm.workflow.editor"` exits 1 with `ModuleNotFoundError`.
- [ ] `git ls-files src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets tests/e2e | wc -l` prints `0`; `python -m build --wheel && unzip -l dist/*.whl | grep -c editor_assets` prints `0`.
- [ ] `git grep -n -E 'e2e-deps|setup-node|editor_assets|REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT|prompt_authoring|criterion_preview' -- Makefile .github pyproject.toml src scripts tests` prints nothing.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check && python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check && python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` exit 0; `grep -c REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT docs/env-vars.md` prints `0`.
- [ ] `python -c "from rebar.llm.prompting.prompt_library import _valid_id,_atomic_write; print(_valid_id('plan-review-G1G2'), _valid_id('a/b'))"` prints `True False`; `pytest tests/unit/test_prompt_library_writes.py -q` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check && python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exit 0 reporting `new=0 increased=0`.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0; the Gerrit change reaches `Verified +1` with no Node setup step in the run log.
